$comment: Floors for the e2e ratchet, read by scripts/check-e2e-manifest.mjs.
One entry per manifest run: the number of tests that run must not fall below `tests`.
Raising a floor is deliberate; lowering one is a decision somebody has to justify in review.
An empty `runs` object is intentional for now: no run has been measured on the CI stack
first green CI run and commit the counts it prints. Until then the integrity checks still
apply and a missing floor is a note, not a failure — inventing a number here would make the
gate lie from its first day.
